description:
Create a new basement level in the DreamPlan Home Design project. You must:
1. Open the Stories/Levels management interface.
2. Add a new story using the 'Basement' template (or set a negative elevation).
3. Ensure the story is named 'Basement'.
4. On this new basement level, draw a foundation wall perimeter that roughly matches the floor above.

The starting state is the default Sample House. You must modify the project structure to include this subterranean level.
